latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of kmind-markdown-to-mindmap skill.

- Converts Markdown outlines or plain text into themed KMind mind map images (SVG/PNG) locally and offline.
- Supports theme presets, layout options, edge routing, appearance (light/dark), and rainbow branches.
- Allows export of editable KMind packages as `.kmindz.svg` for seamless importing into KMind clients.
- Provides both automatic and manual browser export modes, with clear guidance if no local Chromium is available.
- Includes extensive parameter options and defaults for flexible conversion and export workflows.
